correctness.rationale: For any signed representing measure, projection onto the input slope gives a scalar unit-disk measure of no larger TV. Splitting by slope sign and pushing to kink locations yields signed measures with integrable weighted first moments. The affine second derivative forces opposite kink measures; the slope/intercept give exact total mass and first moment. The Euclidean triangle inequality yields cost at least min_c |c|+2sqrt(s^2+(b-c)^2). Its convex minimizer is explicit, and normalized antipodal ReLU atoms plus an optional constant atom attain equality. Boundary cases and the minimal atom count follow. The supplied checker verifies finite evaluations but is not used as an infinite proof.
